leads.title: What electricity providers are York Springs, PA residents using?
leads.snippet: Meted is the primary provider, but some use AEP Energy or IDT Energy, with rates varying and often increasing. $350-$700 a month for electricity is ridiculous.

leads.title: West Penn Power rate hikes prompt more homes to switch to solar
leads.snippet: West Penn Power raised default rates 10.3% on June 1. at $0 down. You pay a lower rate for the power. No loan, no upfront cost, no repair bills. Penn 11.9% 12.
